title: 15.10. Hetuduka, Ācayagāmittika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Hetuṁ ācayagāmiṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu naācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Hetuṁ apacayagāmiṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu naapacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahetuṁ nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṁ dhammaṁ paccayā nanahetu nanevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
